author: SuperCarlinBrothers
description:
Have you ever wondered why Gilderoy Lockhart's favorite color is lilac? Believe it or not... the Harry Potter books actually answer that question.

Today we're diving into five bite-sized Harry Potter theories that were too fun to leave on the cutting room floor. From the hidden meaning behind Lockhart's favorite color to how Love Potions might actually work, whether Regulus Black was a Hatstall, the true identity of the mysterious "Muggle tramp" Voldemort killed to create Slytherin's Locket Horcrux, and why Dumbledore compliments the Dursleys' agapanthus flowers, we're uncovering some of the smallest (and strangest) secrets hidden throughout the Wizarding World.

Sometimes the best Harry Potter theories aren't big enough for their own video... but they're way too good not to share. 

Super Carlin Brothers explore Harry Potter theories, Pixar connections, and all your favorite fandoms every week!
